landing.summary: Display the locations where photos were taken on a map.
landing.photosHaveLocationData: Photos taken with smartphones have location data (latitude and longitude).
landing.showsLocationsOnMap: This application fetches the location data from photos and displays the locations on a map.
landing.troubleshooting: If you encounter issues with this application, please see <link>the troubleshooting page</link>.
landing.sourceCode: The source code of Photo Location Map is <link>hosted on GitHub</link>.
landing.developedBy: Photo Location Map is developed by <link>Tomoyuki Aota</link>.
